name: Enigmatic Origins
body:
Your draconic heritage is far more complex than others.

Prerequisite(s): Wyrmtouched.

Benefit: You may add the following options to those you can select for your draconic breath weapon racial trait, allowing it to deal the listed type of damage:

Bludgeoning
Piercing
Slashing
Negative Energy (this breath weapon cannot be used to heal undead)
Sonic

In addition, you can choose for your draconic resistance to instead grant negative energy resist 5, sonic resist 5, DR 3/bludgeoning, DR 3/piercing, or DR 3/slashing.

Special: You must select this feat at 1st level.

Special: Whenever you choose to deal sonic damage with your breath weapon, your breath weapon’s damage die is reduced by 1 step.
